note: The sprite-size and style probe, second round (issue #11): the man-at-arms at 256 in the look of Ben's knight. v3 from scratch at 256 is the cheap path that also gives a character for east-only animations; generate-with-style-v2 uses the knight itself as the style image for one 256 image. The strict side view came out as a flat profile; a low top-down view is tried too, whose east rotation is a three-quarter view like Ben's knight. generate-with-style-v2 takes its size from the style images (image_size was removed from the API), so the knight frame's 256 canvas sets the output size.
